user.name: Kira
user.notes: Just wants to stay healthy and run consistently. No race planned.

inbound_sms: What should I do for my Thursday run this week?

ground_truth.notes: Today is Wednesday April 8. Kira has no race — she's running for general fitness. She asked what to do for her Thursday run (tomorrow). Response MUST: (1) give a concrete Thursday workout recommendation (distance + pace), (2) NOT mention races, race prep, or race-specific concepts like taper, (3) frame guidance around her general fitness goal. She's logged 6mi so far this week (Tuesday run), target is 18mi, so ~12mi remaining across Thursday and Saturday. A reasonable Thursday recommendation is 5-6mi easy at around 10:00-10:20/mi. Accept any recommendation in the 4-6mi range as valid.
